endorsements.name: Arnoldas Radisauskas
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-59976
endorsements.description: An arbitrary file download vulnerability in the web interface of Juniper Networks Junos Space allows a network-based authenticated attacker using a crafted GET method to access any file on the file system. Using specially crafted GET methods, an attacker can gain access to files beyond the file path normally allowed by the JBoss daemon. These files could contain sensitive information restricted from access by low-privileged users.This issue affects all versions of Junos Space before 24.1R3.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.1)

endorsements.name: Arnoldas Radisauskas
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-59978
endorsements.description:
An Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Juniper Networks Junos Space allows an attacker to store script tags directly in web pages that, when viewed by another user, enable the attacker to execute commands with the target's administrative permissions.
This issue affects all versions of Junos Space before 24.1R4.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.4)
